title: Working From Anywhere
text:
Remote work has changed the way many professionals think about their careers. Today, a software developer in Madrid can work for a company based in Toronto without leaving home. This flexibility allows people to choose where they live and when they work. However, it also requires strong self-discipline and clear communication.

Experts predict that hybrid models, which combine office and home work, will become the norm. Companies are investing in digital tools to keep their teams connected. Nevertheless, some managers worry that informal conversations and mentoring may decline. Therefore, many organisations are scheduling regular in-person meetings to protect these relationships.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does remote work allow people to do?
options: Choose where they live and when they work
Earn more money than office workers
Work only in their home country

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some managers worry may decline?
What can be inferred about hybrid models from the second paragraph?
options: They combine office work with work from home
They eliminate the need for digital tools
They are used only by small companies
They require no communication between staff

questions.text: Why are many organisations scheduling regular in-person meetings?
options: To protect relationships that might weaken when people work apart
To reduce the number of employees
Because remote work has been banned

combining two different things, such as office work and home work
guidance given by an experienced person to help someone develop their career
the usual or standard way that things are done

paragraph_translations: El trabajo remoto ha cambiado la manera en que muchos profesionales piensan sobre sus carreras. Hoy en día, un desarrollador de software en Madrid puede trabajar para una empresa con sede en Toronto sin salir de casa. Esta flexibilidad permite a las personas elegir dónde viven y cuándo trabajan. Sin embargo, también exige una gran autodisciplina y una comunicación clara.

Los expertos predicen que los modelos híbridos, que combinan el trabajo en la oficina y en casa, se convertirán en la norma. Las empresas están invirtiendo en herramientas digitales para mantener a sus equipos conectados. No obstante, algunos gerentes temen que las conversaciones informales y la tutoría disminuyan. Por eso, muchas organizaciones están programando reuniones presenciales periódicas para proteger estas relaciones.
